description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Once per encounter, you may cast Grasping Bloom with a single action instead of its usual casting actions. The spell is otherwise unchanged in every respect — same rank, same range, same area, same Bloom tag and the same one step on the needle. If Grasping Bloom already costs 1 action or less, this feat has no effect on it.

cinderfall.incomplete: No RE alters a *named other spell's* action cost — `CF-list` confirms `ItemAlteration`'s field list has nothing for action cost at all, on any item type. Bucket 3/5.
